title: BF30: 30 Black Friday static batches (90 ads)
angle: Black Friday: 30% off sitewide, no code, prices already reduced (never "taken off at checkout")
rules: Real photos only: Figma Static Ads 1 camera files (DSC...), Shopify listing images, RAW session photos/stills on Frame.io. No AI-filled Figma photos (Static Ads 2), no generated images.
Men's photos only in men's ads, women's only in women's. One finish per ad (C may differ inside a batch).

Brand: light, airy, graphite monochrome, Figtree; headline ~50px 300/400 0.04em; body ~27px 300; logo ~110px; slim square black CTA (80px, 22px label); red #A82C24 only as a small accent on light layouts.
1080x1920; key text inside y 270-1536; ROAS check (roas.js + roas.py) per ad: contrast p10 >= 4.5 (>= 3 for text 24px+).

True claims only: waterproof; sweat and heat resistant; recycled 316L; adjustable S/M/L; black/silver/gold; case included; free shipping; Trustpilot 4.5, 3,000+ reviews. No prices, no currencies, no deadlines, no tarnish/fade claims, no invented named reviews.
Both duo bracelets have small bar tags: never claim otherwise. 3x stack = flat polished cuff bangle + box chain + square chain (never "snake").
No weather/snow/season hook; avoid rejected concepts: snow weather widget, care label, commute route, gift tag "to me from me", magazine "issue" framing.

Do not repeat formats already on the canvas: group chat, lock-screen notifications, calendar reminder, newspaper front page, anatomy of the duo, search results, comment reply, best-friend chat, wishlist board, voice note, POV caption, pick your finish, packing list, notes list, yesterday/today (men), set and case, checklist on photo.

IM8 imitation = closer, more literal copy of the referenced IM8 ad's layout, hierarchy and device (sticker, highlight, panel, list), translated into the Cavaier light graphite look. Put an IM8 refs board (420 wide) in each row that has im8_ref entries.
Motion batches (ad_type IMAGE & VIDEO): C2 is an animated static mp4 (6-8 s, 1080x1920, real photo/footage only, no Seedance, no dark veils behind text) plus a png poster; C1 and C3 are statics.
Before using any photo: perceptual-hash it against bfcm26/figimg/*, bfcm26/frame/**/no text exports and canvas blobs so nothing already on the canvas is reused.
